name: witty-status-api
description: Witty and professional HTTP error and maintenance handling library and standalone API server with responsive HTML page renderers

scripts.build:pages: node --input-type=module -e "import fs from 'fs'; import { STATUS_QUOTES, MAINTENANCE_DATA } from './dist/index.js'; const data = 'window.STATUS_DATA = ' + JSON.stringify({ quotes: STATUS_QUOTES, maintenance: MAINTENANCE_DATA }) + ';'; fs.writeFileSync('./quotes-data.js', data); if (!fs.existsSync('./docs')) fs.mkdirSync('./docs'); fs.writeFileSync('./docs/quotes-data.js', data); console.log('Successfully generated quotes-data.js in root and docs/');"
scripts.prepublishOnly: npm run test && npm run build

author: WittyStatus Contributors
